details: CONFIRMED by the repro below. The brief said: check other tests with the same pattern and fix them if the same cause. The cause
is the same (a hook load leaves its plugin lib on sys.path and its copies in sys.modules); only the symptom differs. Base.setUp's
_drop_relay_modules does not help because the sys.path entry stays, so the next import finds the plugin copy again. Correct
today, fragile: a future in-process test of queue views, or a lib/ change not yet synced to the core copy, fails only in the
full run. LOW, cheap: load_hook already exists. Size: 15 min (8 files, mostly the same one-line swap).
evidence: leak probe (import each test module, list sys.path additions and relay_* modules from plugins/):
worker report: "the others (core hooks ...) leak only ROOT-free copies, not converted"
failing_case: python3 -c: sys.path gets tests and lib; import test_mark_attach (what pytest collection does); drop relay_* from sys.modules
Now: relay_queue.__file__ = plugins/core/hooks/../lib/relay_queue.py and relay_queue.extensions() == [] (no queue_ext beside the copy).
Should: lib/relay_queue.py and extensions() == ['json', 'table'], as without test_mark_attach.
Because pytest imports every test module before running any, from then on every in-process `import relay_queue` / relay_git /
relay_toml / relay_verdict / relay_marks / relay_inert in any test of the run resolves to the core plugin copy. test_check_record
does the same at import (leak probe: path+ plugins/core/lib, relay_inert from plugins). No test is red today: the extension tests
go through a subprocess or patch EXT_DIR.
fix_hint: Use relay_testbase.load_hook in the 8 files that load a hook by spec_from_file_location (test_mark_attach, test_check_record,
test_merge_hook, test_archive_inert, test_queue_in_place, test_read_only_guard, test_merge_train, test_openspec_hook).
pass_cases: 1. Import test_mark_attach, drop relay_* modules, import relay_queue -> lib/relay_queue.py, extensions() == ['json', 'table'].
2. Same with test_check_record -> sys.path has no plugins/core/lib entry afterwards.

3. pytest tests/test_mark_attach.py tests/test_check_record.py tests/test_merge_hook.py tests/test_archive_inert.py tests/test_queue_in_place.py tests/test_read_only_guard.py tests/test_merge_train.py tests/test_openspec_hook.py -> all pass (as now).
reason: tests/test_spec_steps.py:560 passes; fails at 227cc19^. Converted hook-test files pass.
findings.summary: core-hook tests still leave plugins/core/lib first on sys.path for the whole run; the worker's reason for skipping them (ROOT-free copies) is wrong: relay_queue's EXT_DIR is file-relative
